title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E14 — Steve's Croc Mission Lives On
The family makes the annual trip to the Steve Irwin Wildlife Reserve to capture, study and release wild crocodiles, a mission started by Steve and Terri that provides research vital to the protection of Australia's apex predators.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E11 — Swimming With Manta Rays
Robert travels to Australia's Great Barrier Reef to help conduct research on manta rays; the zoo's rescue unit, wildlife hospital and volunteers team up to save a baby wallaby that is struggling to survive.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E10 — Bindi & the Otters
Wes and Robert remove eggs from the nest of saltwater crocodiles Terra and Bosco in a nerve-wracking but necessary venture; Bindi tends to the training of otters Percival and Daisy; Terri makes a zoo volunteer's dream come true.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S02 E01 — Bosco the Croc's Big Move
Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo; Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem; Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season.

title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
description:
S01 E12 — Pawing Terri's Heart
Terri attends the exam of Charlie the tiger to determine if his tumors were successfully treated; Bindi and the Small Mammal Team help develop a vaccine for Eden the Tasmanian devil; Robert discovers the true genders of the zoo's shingleback lizards.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E10 — Journey to Perl Island
The Kilchers face large challenges; Otto, Jane and Shane help a fellow homesteader, but they discover a predator.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E13 — A Hunt Above the Clouds
Changes in the weather force the family away from home in search of food; Eivin and Eve stalk big game; Atz Sr. and Bonnie struggle on the open sea; Charlotte and August face off against bears.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E08 — Thanksgiving on the Homestead
The Kilcher family celebrates Thanksgiving with the friends who helped prepare the homestead for winter.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E14 — Call of the Cattleman
The Kilchers and others pay tribute to a fallen friend with a cattle drive; Atz Lee winterizes the hunter's cabin; a fishing trip ends with a bang.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier Exposed
description:
Snowy Roundup
Jane and Atz Lee go on the last bear hunt of the year; Atz learns a new skill; Otto and Charlotte fight the tides; Eivin practices blacksmithing.

title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
description:
S04 E17 — Will Winter Come?
The Kilchers finalize their winter preparations; Eivin, Atz Lee, Jane and Shane hunt for deer; Otto and Charlotte give a life-changing gift; Atz Lee and Jane consider leaving the homestead.

title: Cats 101
description:
S02 E02 — Manx, Burmese, Siberian, Russian Blue, Cornish Rex, Singapura
The feline that is known as the greyhound of cats; the breed that originated on the Isle of Man; the Siberian that represents Russia; the cat that is the smallest in the world.

title: Cats 101
description:
S03 E03 — Tonkinese, Nebelung, Serengeti, Korat, Cats Gone Wild, RagaMuffin, Toyger
The Tonkinese, Nebelung, Serengeti, Korat, Ragamuffin and the Toyger; adventurous furballs in it for the long haul.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E01 — Black Market Butchers
A suspicious encounter in a quiet neighborhood leads wildlife agents to a black market venison sale. A routine boating check ends with a wanted man in handcuffs, and agents launch a massive search for a 93-year-old boater lost.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E07 — Backroads Outlaw
A suspicious driver leads wildlife agents on a high-speed chase through a national forest; goose-hunting guides are caught in a repeat offense; a routine stop turns treacherous when a suspect is discovered concealing a firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E05 — Buck Hunt Stakeout
A suspicious man fleeing on the levee after dark puts wildlife agents in danger; a first-time bowhunter could lose his kill over a major violation; agents question a duck hunter with an attitude who seems to be hiding something.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E08 — Hail of Gunfire
A barrage of heavy gunfire in an archery-only area puts wildlife agents on high alert; two boaters are stranded on Catahoula Lake; a hunter is caught in an act of fraud; a veteran agent encounters a high-stakes violation on his final patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E04 — Spotlight Killers
When a pair of illegal hunters flee by truck, wildlife agents set out to track them down; heaps of trash dumped at a fishing spot lead to a suspect who denies any wrongdoing; damning evidence in a truck bed catches a hunter in a lie.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E02 — Stalking Bears
LDWF biologists on a conservation mission get hands-on with black bear cubs, facing a protective mama bear; hunters get caught using a banned method to hunt ducks; wildlife agents stake out after dark for a felon with an illegal gun.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E08 — Concealed in a Cooler
A bizarre discovery inside an abandoned cooler escalates a littering probe; wildlife agents patrolling in dense fog are thrown into a dangerous encounter, and a burglary investigation uncovers an illegally taken deer.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E02 — Bobcat on the Loose
A call is made about two bobcats on the loose and Officer McKee must track them down before things escalate; a fisherman is caught concealing his unregistered snowmobile; Officer Cyrs rushes to the site of a head-on snowmobile accident.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E03 — Meltdown
On the Bald Mountain Trail, officers help rescue an injured hiker, but the icy trail puts the whole crew at risk; Officer Egan is the first medical responder to a sudden snowmobile crash, and two four-wheelers crash through ice on Webster Lake.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E01 — Hidden in the Water
As temperatures drop to near-freezing, Officers Canfield and Jones use an ROV to search Merrimack River for a missing person; a man is caught illegally releasing coyotes from traps; officers host a meet-and-greet at the headquarters.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E07 — Raccoon Rescue
With the help of local police, Lt. Boudreau and Officer Hannett remove campers that are illegally occupying state property; an 8-year-old boy is found riding solo on an ATV, and Officer Crouse helps two raccoon cubs found on the road.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E04 — Bump in the Road
Lt. Boudreau and Officer Hannett have an unusually busy day on ATV patrol; Officer McDermott investigates a man who illegally shot a rabbit in a residential area; Officer Holmes and Officer Cyrs use ATVs to rescue an injured hiker on Mount Carter.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E06 — Leading the Way
Sgt. Pushee leads a multi-agency rescue mission to find a missing kayaker; a specialist is called in to locate a pesky bear roaming a residential area; and a boy is caught riding without a helmet and operating his ATV illegally.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E10 — No Place Like Home
During a busy Old Home Day, Officer Delmer patrols the ATV trails; Officer McFadden rescues a trapped barred owl and takes it to be rehabilitated; on Mount Liberty, Officer Towne and trainee LaTourneau save an injured hiker.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E08 — Twists and Turns
Officer McDermott finds an abandoned truck, sparking a winding investigation; Officer Holmes and Sgt. Lucas rescue paddlers near a capsized canoe; Holmes responds to a moose accident, while Officer Frye consoles a bereft woman.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S14 E05 — Case Closed
Lt. Mike Eastman investigates a case of stolen lobster traps; a man on a dirt bike flees the scene after being stopped for speeding; Officer Hannett sends an injured pigeon to a local wildlife rehabber.

Inside Bambino, Pixie Bob, Australian Mist, Domestic Longhair, Cats Gone Wild, Cheetoh and Napoleon.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E07 — Miracle Puppies
Dr. Blue flies into action when a Rottweiler in labor gets rushed into the hospital with two puppies stuck inside her; the three vets grab the reins and their cowboy hats to ride horseback into town for Houston's biggest rodeo parade.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E06 — Little Dog, Big Problem
Dr. Blue discovers a huge problem for a paralyzed Yorkie; Dr. Ross takes care of a pair of post-scuffle roosters, before joining Dr. Lavigne on a hyena consultation; the Lavigne family hosts a dinner party showcasing Anne's cooking skills.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E08 — Tuskegee Reunion
The doctors visit their alma mater for a class reunion and become professors for a day; a shih tzu is rushed to the clinic after swallowing a large piece of rawhide, while the owner of a pit bull with a deformed leg must consider drastic surgery.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S02 E05 — Emergency Engine Cat
Dr. Ross and vet tech Kyerra race to save a stray cat horrifically mangled by a car engine; the Rosses move into their new home while Dr. Blue treats a 700-pound arthritic pig; Dr. Lavigne hears a rescue Chihuahua's incredible story.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E11 — My Cat Ruined My Wedding
A couple's plan to move in together could be derailed due to the destructive behavior of Pink, the cat; a couple has been pushed to their limit because of the terrorizing ways of their demonic cat, Zoey.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E12 — Max Hates My Family
Due to the demonic behavior of Max, a family's bond is ripping at the seams; Capri's aggressive tendencies are draining her owner's new roommate. Unfortunately, if nothing changes she will be evicted.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E10 — Cat Horror Show
A couple's show cat named Snickers has become tormented by the lifestyle and is aggressive towards the judges; Dexter's constant meowing has put his owner over the edge and is desperate for a resolution.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E21 — Feel the Burn
Dropped into Guyana's scorching savannah, two super fans battle the oppressive heat and relentless insect attacks; scorching temperatures lead to severe dehydration and force a desperate fan to risk illness by drinking unsanitary fluids.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E12 — Swamp Don't Care
All-star survivalists Jake Nodar and Melissa Miller take on a punishing Florida swamp teeming with poisonous snakes and aggressive alligators; when one of the survivalists becomes disoriented, authorities are called in to conduct an all-out search.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E14 — For Better or a Lot Worse
The first "Naked and Afraid" couple faces challenges to themselves and their relationship as they take on the relentless Guyana jungle; they must work together to battle jaguars, anacondas, caiman, and more than two-million species of insects.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E02 — Frozen and Afraid
Dropped onto a frozen Alaskan glacier, all-star survivalists Laura Zerra and Steven Hall scramble to stave off frostbite and hypothermia; 7,000 miles south, two new survivalists take on a sun-scorched Brazil island, with anaconda and deadly stingray.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E18 — Honduran Hell
In the mountainous rainforest of Honduras, a survivalist with an unusual past is paired with a hard-headed police detective to try and survive 21 days, but predatory jaguars, swarms of fire ants and a debilitating injury threaten their challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E06 — The Beauty and the Bro
A bro bachelor and a divorcée attempt to survive a 14-day fan challenge plagued by unrelenting heat, venomous centipedes and swarms of bees on a remote island in the Philippines; their biggest battle will be with each other.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E05 — Runaway Bride
A survivalist postpones her wedding to try to make it to 21 days with a British commando in the mosquito-infested Colombian tropics.

American Curl kittens prepare for life on the catwalk, a set of Tonkinese run circles around mum, and a Maine Coon tries to show who's boss.

Facts and trivia about border collies, Chinese cresteds, English mastiffs, Italian greyhounds and Lhasa Apsos.

description:
S01 E02 — Wicked Bite
Jim Lane picks blueberries alone in the Blue Ridge Mountains until a timber rattlesnake attacks; teacher Rachael Lilienthal's swim in a Florida river becomes a struggle when an alligator bites down on her arm, pulls her underwater and doesn't let go.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S01 E04 — Silent Scream
A polar bear chases down Erin Greene as she walks home from a Halloween party in a small arctic town; a bull shark attacks triathlete Chuck Anderson in the Gulf of Mexico, biting his arm and pulling him to the ocean floor.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S01 E03 — Blood in the Water
A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains; miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E04 — Rattlesnake in My Car
A rattlesnake takes a dip in a pool, while another hides out in a woman's car; Capt. Seifert encounters a blood python.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E06 — Monsters in the Backyard
A 13-foot python takes a dip in a neighborhood pool on Christmas morning.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E01 — Florida's Born Killers
Southern Florida is filled with dangerous examples of native wildlife, including rattlesnakes, cottonmouths and alligators.

title: Swamp Wars
description:

A monstrous Burmese python poses a threat to the children of a day care center; the team extracts venom from a king cobra to be used as antidote.

The rivers of Guyana may host a real freshwater mermaid that the locals call the Water Mama.

Wade comes face-to-face with one of South America's greatest freshwater fighting fish.

title: River Monsters
description:
Amazon Apocalypse
Wade is on the hunt to find out what was behind the Sobral Santos attack on the Amazon River, where more than 200 passengers were killed on a pitch-black night.

title: River Monsters
description:
S06 E04 — Man-Eating Monster
Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E04 — Alaska's Cold Water Killer
A recent fatal incident in the Alaskan wilderness sends Jeremy on a quest for possible suspects that culminates in a showdown with an unexpected, bizarre water beast.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E05 — South Pacific Terrors
Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

description:
S07 E01 — Canadian Horror
Jeremy Wade investigates rumors of a twenty-foot lake monster that attacks people; with snakes, freshwater sharks and giant sturgeon unlikely possibilities, the answer as to what it is drives Jeremy crazy.

description:
S06 E02 — Jungle Terminator
Wade teams up with a local tribe to solve three mysterious deaths in three different South American countries.
